theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_limit_of_local_cauchy
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Set (Rn N)), (∀ k, NullMeasurableSet (F k) volume) → (∀ (R : ℕ) (ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < ε → ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, ∀ l ≥ k₀, volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R ∩ symmDiff (F k) (F l)) ≤ ε) → ∃ G : Set (Rn N), MeasurableSet G ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → Tendsto (fun k ↦ volume (K ∩ symmDiff (F k) G)) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
